Simd/TargetAnnotation.reason: A [target("avx2", "fma")] function compiles to AVX2 and FMA and runs where the processor has them; HasProcessorFeature agrees with itself.

Interop/Bug326DeprecatedInHeader.reason: BUG-326: the shim CBind writes forwards a header's deprecated declarations without the header's deprecation warnings.

Interop/Bug319AbstractInterfaces.reason: BUG-319: an abstract class without a virtual destructor (a COM interface) gets no destructor binding, so CBind's shim never calls ~T() on it and builds without warnings.

Interop/Bug317IncludeFolders.reason: BUG-317: the build's include folders reach CBind and the foreign C compile, so a bound header can include a vendored header from them.

Platform/WindowsSubsystem.reason: --subsystem windows links a windowed program: its PE header names the GUI subsystem (2), and main is still its entry, so it runs and returns the value it reads.

Platform/ResourceFile.reason: -l with a .res file links the compiled resources as they are: the executable has a resource directory (app.res is llvm-rc's output for app.rc).

Exceptions/UncaughtException.reason: An uncaught throw must terminate the process with a non-zero exit code and never run the code after the throw.

Exceptions/UncaughtExceptionCount.reason: An uncaught throw must terminate before the post-throw printf runs; a corrupted g_count or a printed REACHED line means control escaped c4_throw.

MemoryGC/FinalizerException.reason: An exception escaping a finalizer stops the program; it never unwinds through the collector into the caller of the collection.

mustContain: an exception left a noexcept function
Lifecycle/NoexceptTerminates.reason: An exception leaving a noexcept function stops the program (D-13); the caller's catch-all never sees it.

Lifecycle/ExitDestruction.reason: Globals, static members and static locals are destroyed after main returns, last constructed first; the first-constructed object checks the order and exits with 42.

Lifecycle/StaticLocalReentry.reason: A static local's start that recurses into its own declaration stops the program instead of deadlocking or running twice.

TestingFramework/ClassGroupPrefix.reason: A class's [test(...)] prefixes its methods' groups; a bare method test is named by its function (BUG-021).

compileMustContain: main.cf (6:17) warning: the conversion from 'int64' to 'int16' may change the value
main.cf (3:2) warning: unknown annotation 'operater': did you mean 'operator'?
Diagnostics/WarningsDoNotFail.reason: Warnings are printed and the build still succeeds; constants that fit do not warn (B22).

compileMustContain: main.cf (4:47) warning: the conversion from 'uint32' to 'uint8' may change the value
main.cf (5:35) warning: the conversion from 'uint32' to 'uint8' may change the value
Diagnostics/Bug336ConditionalConstants.reason: BUG-336: a conditional whose arms are constants that fit converts without a warning; an arm that may not fit warns.

compileMustContain: main.cf (2:19) warning: the conversion from 'int32' to 'uint8' may change the value
main.cf (3:27) warning: the conversion from 'double' to 'int32' may change the value
Diagnostics/GlobalStartWarnings.reason: BUG-230: a global that starts as a constant gets the conversion warnings a local's start gets.

Lifecycle/ThreadLocalEndsBeforeGlobals.reason: The main thread's thread_local objects start after the globals and end at exit before them.

Lifecycle/ThreadLocalReentry.reason: A thread_local local's start that recurses into its own declaration on the same thread stops the program.

mustContain: an exception escaped the destruction of a global, static or thread_local object
Lifecycle/ThreadLocalDeleteThrows.reason: An exception escaping a thread_local's delete as its thread ends stops the program.

mustContain: an exception was thrown and not caught
Threads/UncaughtInThread.reason: An exception escaping a thread's entry ends the process like one escaping main: every attached thread installs the terminate handler.

mustContain: FAIL: main.cf:4: one is not two (expected 1, got 2)
TestingFramework/FailureFileLine.reason: A failure names its assertion's file and line (B37), and the exit code is the failed-assertion count (BUG-038).

TestingFramework/AssertionLine.reason: Each failed assertion prints its own line, including one inside a call in another assertion's arguments (B37).

mustContain: FAIL: throwing.first: an exception left the test
TestingFramework/ThrowingTest.reason: An exception that leaves a test fails that case and the run goes on to the next (B37).

TestingFramework/JsonSummary.reason: -test-json writes a valid JSON summary with a cases array, escaping names (BUG-038).

TestingFramework/GroupFilter.reason: --filter runs only the matching cases; the fixtures still run.

Simd/WideVectorsAvx2.reason: D-62: with AVX2 a 256-bit vector is returned in YMM0, read with aligned AVX loads (a misaligned container element would fault: BUG-251), gathered and masked; the macros name the target.

Simd/NativeTarget.reason: D-62: -march=native compiles for the building machine; SIMD_FLOAT_LANES picks 16 lanes with AVX-512, 8 with AVX.

Simd/FusedMultiplyAdd.reason: D-62: simd_fma rounds once (it needs fma, which -mfma turns on with avx).

Interop/SimdIntrinsicsInC.reason: D-62: a C source built with the same -march uses AVX2 / FMA intrinsics on 256-bit vectors C4 passes and gets back in YMM registers.

Platform/ProtectionFaults.reason: Platform page rights hold: each forbidden access faults at its address under Scripting::Guard, which needs a script host (D-63).
